content: If the wak e - up mode of the corresponding transceiver is ETHTRCV_WUM_ENABLE the function EthTrcv_CheckWakeup() shall check if a wake up has been detected and if yes propagate the corresponding wake up source (see EthTrcvWakeupMap configuration) to the EcuM by calling EcuM_SetWakeupEvent.

{DRAFT} If EthTrcvWakeUpSupport is set to ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_ INTERRUPT , the function EthTrcv_CheckWakeup() shall check if a wake up has been detected and if yes propagate the corresponding wake up source (see EthTrcvWakeupMap configuration) to the EcuM by calling EcuM_SetWakeupEvent.

If EthTrcvWakeUpSupport is set to ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_ BY_INTERRUPT or ETHTRCV_WAKEUP_BY_POLLING, the function EthTrcv_Check Wakeup() shall check if a wake up has been detected and if yes propagate the cor- responding wake up source (see EthTrcvWakeupMap configuration [ECUC_EthTrcv_- 00027]) to the EcuM by calling EcuM_SetWakeupEvent.
